title: Lexical call scope
requirement: WHEN a named call enters its body, the interpreter SHALL evaluate it under the declared parameter bindings and global function table.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Caller-local preservation
scenarios.when: An outer let binds x=7 while a called function binds its own x=2 and returns 2.
scenarios.then: The caller still reads x=7 after return.

expected.meaning: f(2) returns 2 from its own x; caller x remains 7, so 2 + 7

checks.label: caller-local x preserved
